query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) as total_molecules,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tp.molecule_id) as with_therapeutic,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT tp.molecule_id)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) * 100, 1) as coverage_pct
FROM molecules m
LEFT JOIN therapeutic_properties tp ON tp.molecule_id = m.id;
